text:
Predicates:
FinancialAid(x) ::: x provides financial aid.
ProveHardship(x) ::: x proves economic hardship.
EconomicHardship(y) ::: y refers to difficulty caused by having too little money or resources.
LivesInFamily(x, y) ::: x lives in family y.
ParentFamily(x) ::: y is a single-parent family.
HasBeenOutOfWorkForMoreThanAYear(y) ::: y's parent has been out of work for more than a year.
Premises:
ETS provides financial aid to those who prove economic hardship.
Economic hardship refers to difficulty caused by having too little money or resources.
Tom lives in a single-parent family.
His dad has been out of work for more than a year.
Conclusion:
∃x (FinancialAid(x) ∧ ProveHardship(x)) ::: Tom can apply for financial aid from ETS to take the GRE test.
